tool.name: wvr
tool.shortdescription: Operate on ALMA Water Vapour Radiometer (WVR) data

method.name: gcal
method.shortdescription: Generate a calibration table based on the WVR data in the given MS
method.description: Generate a gain table based on Water Vapour Radiometer data

param.name: vis
param.description: Input measurement set

param.name: output
param.description: Name of the output file

param.name: toffset
param.description: Time offset (in seconds) between interferometric and WVR data

param.name: nsol
param.description: Number of solutions for phase correction coefficients to make during this observation

param.name: segsource
param.description: Do a new coefficient calculation for each source

param.name: reverse
param.description: Reverse the sign of correction in all SPW (e.g. due to AIV-1740)

param.name: reversespw
param.description: Reverse the sign correction for these spws

param.name: disperse
param.description: Apply correction for dispersion

param.name: cont
param.description: UNTESTED! Estimate the continuum (e.g., due to clouds)

param.name: wvrflag
param.description: Regard this WVR (labelled with either antenna number or antenna name) as bad, and use interpolated values instead. (Can be comma-separated list without spaces.)

param.name: sourceflag
param.description: Flag the WVR data for this source and do not produce any phase corrections on it

param.name: statfield
param.description: Compute the statistics (Phase RMS, Disc) on this field only

param.name: statsource
param.description: Compute the statistics (Phase RMS, Disc) on this source only

param.name: tie
param.description: Prioritise tieing the phase of these sources as well as possible

param.name: smooth
param.description: Smooth WVR data by this many samples before applying the correction

param.name: scale
param.description: Scale the entire phase correction by this factor

param.name: maxdistm
param.description: Maximum distance (m) an antenna may have to be considered for being part of the set of up to 3 antennas for interpolation of a solution for a flagged antenna

param.name: minnumants
param.description: Minimum number of near antennas (up to 3) required for interpolation

param.name: mingoodfrac
param.description: If the fraction of unflagged data for an antenna is below this value (0. to 1.), the antenna is flagged

param.name: usefieldtab
param.description: Derive the antenna pointing information from the FIELD table instead of the POINTING table

param.name: spw
param.description: Only write out corrections for these SPWs.

param.name: wvrspw
param.description: Only use data from these WVR SPWs.

param.name: refant
param.description: Use the WVR data from this antenna for calculating the dT/dL parameters. (Can be comma-separated ranked list without spaces.)

param.name: offsets
param.description: Name of the optional input table containing the temperature offsets, e.g. generated by remove_cloud
